  function T(){ var l = String(document.documentElement.getAttribute('lang') || 'pt').toLowerCase().slice(0, 2); return TEXTOS[l] || TEXTOS.pt; }

  function botoes(t){

  }
  function montar(){
    if (document.querySelector('.dps,.dps-faixa,.dps-land')) return;
    var t = T(), st = document.createElement('style');
    st.textContent = CSS; document.head.appendChild(st);
    if (MODO === 'landing') {
      var g = document.createElement('section');
      g.className = 'dps-land'; g.id = 'parceiro-paysuite'; g.setAttribute('aria-label', t.selo);

      g.innerHTML = '<div class="dps-land-c">' + logo() + '<div><div class="dps-land-sup"><i></i>' + esc(t.oficial) + '</div><h2>' + tit + '</h2><p>' + esc(t.l_texto) + '</p>'

      var heroi = secs[0], rodape = document.querySelector('footer');
      if (heroi && heroi.parentNode) heroi.parentNode.insertBefore(g, heroi.nextSibling);
      else if (rodape && rodape.parentNode) rodape.parentNode.insertBefore(g, rodape);
      else document.body.appendChild(g);
      return;
    }
    if (MODO === 'faixa') {
      var f = document.createElement('div');
      f.className = 'dps-faixa';
      f.innerHTML = '<a href="' + LINK_PAYSUITE + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="' + esc(t.selo) + '">' + logo()
        + '<span><small>' + esc(t.parceiro) + '</small><b>PaySuite</b><em>' + esc(t.landing) + '</em></span></a>';
      var rod = document.querySelector('footer');
      if (rod && rod.parentNode) rod.parentNode.insertBefore(f, rod); else document.body.appendChild(f);
      return;
    }
    var c = document.createElement('section');
    c.className = 'dps' + (MODO === 'curto' ? ' curto' : '');
    c.setAttribute('aria-label', t.selo);
    c.innerHTML = logo() + '<div><div class="dps-sup">' + esc(t.parceiro) + ' <b>PaySuite</b></div>'

        : '<p>' + esc(t.curto) + '</p>')
      + botoes(t) + '</div>';
    var alvo = document.querySelector('.main') || document.querySelector('main') || document.body;
    var antes = MODO === 'completo' ? (alvo.querySelector('.cards') || alvo.firstElementChild) : alvo.firstElementChild;
    if (antes && antes.parentNode === alvo) alvo.insertBefore(c, antes); else if (antes && antes.parentNode) antes.parentNode.insertBefore(c, antes); else alvo.appendChild(c);
  }
